summary: Nine metres of kerb on a multi-lane arterial with no parking.
reasons: Stretch barely over a van length

best_section.where: Moggill Road kerb beside the car park's landscaped entrance

drivers.seclusion: No dwellings within 36 m; car park and verge behind, but exposed to a busy road.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb runs straight into a through lane with a grass verge behind; no pull-out bay.
drivers.traffic: Multi-lane arterial with heavy traffic and turning lanes.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this kerb and no marked parking lane.

sun_shade: Open to sun; a few small trees to the east and south-east.
